name: setup-watch
description: Updates can add skills, tools and MCP servers without telling you, and each one quietly eats context. setup-watch tells you at session start what changed under you since your last session, so you can disable what you don't use.

trackOwn.title: Track your own changes
trackOwn.description: Also report what you changed yourself: plugins you install or uninstall, your ~/.claude skills and commands, and MCP servers you add.
